column1: # Model candidate evaluation lab -- one VM per model, for A/B/C comparison
# (not the production swap-based router; that's a postponed implementation
# decision -- see model-lab/README.md).
# Columns (tab-separated): label vmid hostname ip mac cores mem_mb disk_gb hf_repo hf_file
# VERIFIED against live Hugging Face API listings (each repo's file list +
# license tag actually fetched, not assumed from training knowledge -- see
# docs/brain-session-log.md for corrections this surfaced, most recently
# 2026-09-23's OLMo generation swap). Re-verify before reuse if this file
# is much older than that; quant repos and license tags do change.
# 2026-09-23: olmo2-1b retired and replaced with olmo3-7b -- OLMo 2 1B was
# NOT AI2's newest or biggest public model (OLMo 3 / 3.1 exist, up to
# 32B). The four smallest guests below were briefly resized 2->1 vCPU to
# free budget for olmo3-7b plus a separate, not-in-this-file olmo3-32b
# comparison guest (VMID 117, 192.168.0.167), then restored to 2 vCPU the
# same day once the host cap was raised 50%->80% and made that
# unnecessary -- the 1-vCPU setting was a real, if temporary, cause of
# test timeouts under full-suite load, not just a cosmetic downgrade.
# olmo3-32b is kept out of this manifest deliberately since it's a
# one-off comparison box, not part of the standard set this file drives
# via create-model-vms.sh/setup-all.sh.
# Licenses as verified: apache-2.0 for OLMo/Qwen/Granite/Mistral, mit for
# Phi. One real catch during the original verification pass: Qwen2.5-3B-
# Instruct is NOT apache-2.0 -- it's under the restrictive "Qwen Research
# License" (non-commercial). Swapped for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, confirmed
# apache-2.0, instead of silently keeping a mislicensed candidate.
# MACs are a distinct block (AA:CC:1x) from the pre-existing guests'
# AA:BB:xx MACs -- deliberately non-overlapping.
olmo3-7b
qwen-coder-1.5b
qwen2.5-1.5b
phi-3.5-mini
granite-2b
mistral-7b
